market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a volatile 1-3 month window: Iran conflict keeps oil elevated and risk premiums high; Warsh's hawkish tilt pressures bonds and gold; S&P 500's strong August may give way to September seasonality weakness. Yen intervention and EM rotation provide offsetting support. Expect 3-5% equity volatility with energy outperforming.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook is cautiously constructive: AI capex cycle and EM structural growth support equities, but rate-hike risk and geopolitical fragmentation cap upside. Energy transition (Australia wind, Indonesia commodity exchange) and fintech expansion (Syria payments) drive secular themes. Labor market softening may force Fed to pivot by Q1 2027.
